items.exampleEn: Excuse me, I need to make a phone call.
items.exampleZh: 不好意思，我需要打個電話。

items.exampleEn: The water is too cold to take a shower.
It's late. Go and take a bath now.
Can I take a photo of your dog?
items.exampleZh: 我可以幫你的狗拍張照嗎？

items.exampleEn: You look tired. Why don't you take a break?
items.exampleZh: 你看起來很累，要不要休息一下？

items.exampleEn: Do you usually take a bus to school?
My grandparents take a walk in the park every evening.
items.exampleZh: 我的祖父母每天傍晚在公園散步。

items.sentenceEn: She took a photo of the beautiful sky.
items.sentenceZh: 她拍了一張美麗天空的照片。

items.audioEn: Sorry, Jack can't talk now. He's taking a shower.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，Jack 現在不能講話，他在淋浴。
items.questionZh: Jack 現在為什麼不能講話？
options: He is still asleep in bed

items.sentenceEn: He went outside to make a phone call.
Let's take a walk after dinner.

items.stemEn: It's too far to walk. Let's ____ to the zoo.
items.stemZh: 走路去太遠了，我們搭公車去動物園吧。

items.stemEn: We've worked for three hours. Let's ____ for ten minutes.
items.stemZh: 我們已經工作三個小時了，休息十分鐘吧。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, my family went to the beach. Dad's car was broken, so we took a bus there. We took a walk along the beach, and I took a photo of a big ship. In the afternoon, Mom made a phone call to Grandma and told her about our day. In the evening, we ate out at a small restaurant. When we got back home, I took a bath and slept very well.
items.passageZh: 上星期天，我們全家去海邊。爸爸的車壞了，所以我們搭公車去。我們沿著海灘散步，我拍了一張大船的照片。下午，媽媽打電話給奶奶，跟她說我們這一天的事。晚上，我們在一家小餐廳吃飯。回到家以後，我泡了個澡，睡得很好。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼搭公車去海邊？

items.promptZh: 我哥哥昨天沒有時間淋浴。
referenceEn: My brother didn't have time to take a shower yesterday.
Yesterday my older brother had no time to take a shower.
My big brother didn't have time to take a shower yesterday.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 take a shower 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 have a shower、shower 等）也算對
昨天的事用過去式（例如 didn't have time、had no time 等）
「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother、big brother 等

items.promptZh: 我爺爺喜歡在睡前泡澡。
referenceEn: My grandpa likes to take a bath before bed.
My grandfather likes to take a bath before bed.
My grandpa likes taking a bath before bed.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 take a bath、taking a bath 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 have a bath、bathe 等）也算對
like 後面可接 to＋原形動詞或動名詞（例如 likes to take、likes taking 等）；習慣用現在簡單式
「爺爺」可寫，例如 grandpa、grandfather 等；「睡前」可寫，例如 before bed、before he goes to sleep 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：SUS §12.3：與 a2-p03-l03-q15 同為「家人＋每天＋生活習慣」句型，改過去否定句
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "我哥哥昨天沒有時間淋浴。"（原 "我哥哥每天早上都會淋浴。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：參考答案同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["My brother didn't have time to take a shower yesterday.", "Yesterday my older brother had no time to take a shower.", "My big brother didn't have time to take a shower yesterday."]（原 ["My brother takes a shower every morning.", "My older brother takes a shower every morning.", "Every morning, my brother takes a shower."]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：裁示 1：翻譯要點收不用片語但正確的說法（SUS：showers）；時態要點隨題目改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["建議用片語表達，例如 take a shower 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 have a shower、shower 等）也算對", "昨天的事用過去式（例如 didn't have time、had no time 等）", "「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother、big brother 等"]（原 ["「淋浴」用片語表達，例如 takes a shower 等；寫 has a shower 也正確", "每天的習慣用現在簡單式（例如 takes、always takes 等）", "「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother、big brother 等"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正：裁示 1：翻譯要點收不用片語但正確的說法（FIX：have a bath）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "建議用片語表達，例如 take a bath、taking a bath 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 have a bath、bathe 等）也算對"（原 "「泡澡」用片語表達，例如 take a bath、taking a bath 等"）
